notes: The assimilated article token of לַכֹּל is a real morpheme under rule 12 and is unrepresented, the ASV writing 'to all' with no 'the'.
'tender mercies' heads on 'mercies' under rule 31's tie-break, the ASV writing that noun alone for רַחֲמִים elsewhere, so 'tender' is its specifier; the competing reading heads on 'tender'.
עַל is the predicate of the second verbless clause and takes the supplied copula under rule 49.
